About me
Services Portfolio Features Better together

Hi, my name is Jairo Santacruz. I am a sound engineer working across audio post production. Focused on telling stories through sound

I have contributed to high-profile productions featured on major streaming platforms, including Disney+, Netflix, and HBO Max, as well as a diverse range of independent film and audiovisual projects.

My expertise lies in cinematic sound design, Foley editing, dialogue editing and restoration, and audio post-production. I also specialize in immersive audio for VR and multimedia experiences, with a strong focus on delivering high-quality binaural and Ambisonic mixes that enhance spatial realism and audience immersion.

My Services

  • Use of high-quality, royalty-free sound libraries.
  • Sound effects and soundscape design crafted to enhance your story.
  • Microphone techniques for Foley recording.
  • AI-powered tools for creating unique sound designs.
  • Multitrack dialogue editing for film.
  • Dialogue cleanup and restoration using iZotope RX.
  • Dialogue editing for podcasts and commercial voice-overs (VO).
  • Sound effects and soundscape design for immersive environments.
  • Immersive audio mixing using first-order and higher-order ambisonic plugin suites.
  • Binaural audio mixing.
  • Use of VR headsets for better monitoring of immersive mix.
  • Production sound recording knowledge that can be applied in post-production.
  • Let's talk about it! Is your film going through a new cut? I can coordinate the re-conform between picture and audio.
